featured_reviews.name: Tarabai Shinde
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had the worst experience at the Versova Third Wave outlet.

I paid the bill, but their machine did not generate the payment slip. The payment status showed as completed, and the amount was deducted from my account. However, they told us that the payment was not received and that it might get reverted within a few minutes.

We had our meal, and while leaving, we again confirmed whether they had received the payment or not. Their team said they still hadn’t received it and asked us to pay again if we were leaving. They assured us that if the amount did not get reverted within 24 hours, they would provide a meal worth the same amount since the issue was from their end.

We agreed, paid again, and left.

We waited for 24 hours, but nothing happened. When we contacted them, they asked us to wait for 7 days. We waited for 10 days and revisited the place, but their behavior had completely changed and was very nonchalant.

They asked us to bring a printed bank statement from that day until the current date. I have one question: if the payment was completed to their bank, can’t they check the status from their end? If there are trust issues, that should be handled internally.

Another thing is that for ₹738, sharing my full transaction history and detailed bank statement with a café felt excessive. I’ve made some critical and large transactions from that account, and I’m uncomfortable sharing personal financial details.

One more point I want to mention: while we were placing the order and making the payment, another customer was in a hurry. The person taking orders processed her payment immediately after ours, and both transactions were handled in parallel. I believe this issue happened due to poor management.

That café is not close to my place, and traveling there again just to check the payment status is not worth it.

The owner mentioned that this is a very generic issue and has happened with other customers earlier. This does not sound acceptable. If this is a known issue, they should fix it instead of letting customers suffer.

Avoid this place if you can.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi Tarabai,

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and frustration caused by this experience at our Versova outlet. This is certainly not the level of service or professionalism we strive to offer. We would request that you share your order/contact details via the below link or write to care@thirdwavecoffee.in so that we can look into it. https://forms.office.com/r/hhDUDRi4MY

featured_reviews.name: Dr Prasad Kamble
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently visited Third Wave Coffee and tried a mix of their food and beverages. Here’s our experience:

Spicy Chicken Sandwich – This was a solid choice. The chicken was crispy and well-seasoned, with a nice level of spice. The bun was soft, and the portion size was decent. It could have used a bit more sauce to balance the heat, but overall, it was satisfying.

Strawberry Milkshake – Creamy and rich, with a fresh strawberry flavor. It wasn’t overly sweet, which we appreciated. The consistency was just right—not too thick or too runny.

Choco Caramel Latte – This one was a winner. The balance between chocolate, caramel, and coffee was spot on. It had a smooth texture and wasn’t too sugary, making it a great choice for those who enjoy a well-balanced flavored coffee.

Choco Hazelnut Frappe – If you love Nutella-like flavors, this frappe won’t disappoint. It was indulgent, chocolatey, and had a good hazelnut kick. The texture was creamy, and it wasn’t overly icy.

The ambiance of Third Wave Coffee was cozy, making it a great place to sit and relax. Service was quick and friendly. Overall, a good experience, and we’d definitely return to try more!

On the fourth time, Ekjot said, “I will make a drink for you,” and the one she made tasted perfect.
Throughout the whole time, the staff was amazing — smiling, patient, and genuinely helpful. I shared with Ekjot about my throat infection, and she kindly reassured me, saying she would make my coffee personally so it would be safe for my throat. Her kindness, warmth, and dedication truly stood out.
Ekjot was extremely welcoming, sweet, and hardworking. I really appreciate how she made me feel like a special customer. Because of her and the wonderful staff, I will definitely be coming back to the store.
Thank you, Ekjot, for your exceptional service!❤️❤️

featured_reviews.review_text:
Lovely place to sit and work. Located just off Versova beach, Blue Tokai has found a great outlet, with a mix of both indoor and outdoor seating. Being a pet-friendly cafe, there are also plenty of dogs loitering around, which is a very cute and welcome distraction.

Blue Tokai has made apt use of the space, with tables in the verandah if you wish to smoke. And ample seating inside, but a lot of seats do not have access to charging plug points. I enjoyed the breezy and streamlined look of the shop, a very Tokai-vibe indeed.

My major problems are with the wobbly tables. Their height is just slightly off. A lot of them are wobbly and occasionally pressed against the wall to maximize the space within the store. They are also dusty perpetually, and the staff doesn't care enough to do it. Another problem is that when you open the door, a massive gust of wind is all that you can hear, causing much annoyance if you're focusing on something important.

The coffee is great and always will be great. Can be the perfect coffee shop if not for the multitude of distractions.

featured_reviews.name: Udit Khurana
featured_reviews.review_text:
Silk Road Coffee has slowly become my go to place in Versova, both to relax and to get some work done.

The coffee here is consistently great. I am usually not a fan of cold coffees, but their Vietnamese coffee was exceptionally well balanced and genuinely enjoyable.

They have a diverse range of food options, from lighter fresh options to more indulgent ones. The tiramisu french toast is amazing and definitely worth trying. Another thing I love is that they bake their breads fresh, which really shows in the quality of the food.

And the croissants absolutely deserve a special mention. They proudly say, “Who needs Paris when you have Silk Road for croissants,” and honestly, coming from someone who has actually spent time trying croissants across Paris, they are not wrong. Probably the best croissant I have had.

I also love the small cookies they serve alongside the coffee, a small touch that adds a lot to the experience.

The only small issue is that the common cushion seating could use a bit more regular cleaning.

Overall, a wonderful café with great coffee, comforting food, and an atmosphere that makes you want to keep coming back.

featured_reviews.review_text:

Coming to the point of the place: coffee… awesome flavors and options. Had the Vietnamese iced and it was fabulous. In addition to coffees, they also serve some refreshers and the tepache was so good that it was a no-brainer re-order. The food is also super quality… had the burrata sandwich, marinara sandwich, and the avocado salad and all of them were delectable. The bakery items are simply out of the world. Nothing compares to the croissant and pain au chocolate - do not miss (if it isn’t out of stock that is). Overall a fantastic place and btw saw a bunch of people working here as well - given the quietness around it seems like a perfect place to deal with your pesky boss or client 😉

featured_reviews.name: Dr Prasad Kamble
featured_reviews.review_text:
Cafe Holiday is a delightful spot that offers a cozy ambiance and a diverse menu that caters to a variety of tastes. During our recent visit, we tried the Non-Veg Platter, Lasooni Kebab, Strawberry Smoothie, and a Pizza, and overall, it was a satisfying experience.

The Non-Veg Platter was a hearty and flavorful choice. It came with a generous assortment of grilled chicken, kebabs, and tikkas, all well-marinated and cooked to perfection. The smoky flavor and tender texture of the meats were impressive, and the accompanying dips and salads complemented the dish nicely. It’s a great option for sharing or for someone with a big appetite.

The Lasooni Kebab was a standout dish. The garlic flavor was prominent but not overpowering, and the kebabs were juicy and well-spiced. They had a perfect char on the outside while remaining soft and succulent inside. Definitely a must-try for garlic lovers!

The Strawberry Smoothie was refreshing and perfectly balanced—not too sweet, with a natural fruity flavor. It was thick, creamy, and felt like a great way to cool down after the spicy kebabs. The freshness of the strawberries was evident, making it a delightful drink.

The pizza we ordered was decent, with a thin, crispy crust and a good amount of toppings.

Cafe Holiday is a great place to enjoy a meal with friends or family. The Non-Veg Platter and Lasooni Kebab were the highlights of our visit, and the Strawberry Smoothie was a refreshing treat. We’ll definitely be returning to try more items from their menu!

Shaped by fermentation in bio-fermenters and slow, controlled drying in the estate’s dark room, the cup is vibrant and expressive. Its silky body and bright mouthfeel reminded our roasters of sparkling wine.

We recommend brewing it on an AeroPress or as a Pour Over.
Head to the link in our bio to order. 💙

featured_reviews.name: Asma Ikram
featured_reviews.review_text: Food is average, I had grilled chicken skewers and strawberry foam cold coffee. Vibe is amazing and the comic theme + Library is soooo cool ❤️

featured_reviews.name: Divyansh Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
tried a bunch:
- Vietnamese Coffee, Oreo Shake- hit the spot!
- Food:Chicken Burger, Chicken Steak w/ Crispy Potato, Mushroom & Cheese Sandwich, Chicken Sandwich, Pesto Pasta - all solid.
- Grilled Mushroom w/ Multigrain Bread & Dip- yum!

Pros:
- Unique vibe, new concept
- Booze & books (whole library downstairs!)
- Good for a quick bite & vibe

Cons:
Sitting’s kinda cramped, not for long stays
Pricey-ish, won’t be a regular

Swing by for the vibe & food, worth a visit. Their pancakes were too! Would I go back often? Meh, but definitely recommend for a one-time chill.

featured_reviews.name: Natalie Sovereign
featured_reviews.review_text:
I've spent more days than I'd like to admit at Leaping Windows. I love their selection of Moonshine, their salads are awesome and so are their staff. I will miss it once I leave. The comic room downstairs seems to pass over the heads of many people, mine included, so if you're reading this take your drink down and enjoy the large selection of graphic novels and comics both Indian and international.
The place is always lively and the food is consistently good. I only wish they had ordinary fried instead of only sweet potato ones. Personal preference!

featured_reviews.name: kamlesh kotenkar
featured_reviews.review_text: Having visited this place several times this is a delayed review. Leaping window needs no introductions. A quiet place serving great food with great service. Tucked away in a quiet corner of yari road, this place is a must visit.

I ordered egg kejriwal and coffee with chocolate. Both of them were yummy. Also the environment of this cafe is quite cool. I didn’t had time to explore the comics but the collection seemed quite extensive.

featured_reviews.name: Akshay Sakhare
featured_reviews.review_text: The avocado sunrise delight is a must try. The setting is very cozy and comfortable. The pancakes could have been more fluffy and it was very sweet.

featured_reviews.name: Janhavi Raut
featured_reviews.review_text:
It was a really nice cafe with a cozy environment that was especially peaceful when we visited at night, as there wasn't much rush. The service was fast, which was great. We had been wanting to try their Caesar salad for a long time, and it did not disappoint - the flavors of every vegetable came through nicely. If you prefer spicy food, this might not be for you, but I enjoyed it. We also tried the Kombucha, which was nice. I'd recommend drinking it at room temperature, as asking for it chilled resulted in it being served over ice in a glass.

The best part about this cafe is the warm hospitality - they serve water as soon as you enter, which I really appreciate. It's a lovely gesture that sets a positive tone for the visit. Overall, the ambience was fantastic, and I'd definitely suggest visiting.

featured_reviews.name: Merin
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited this cafe and had a great overall experience. I ordered the Chicken Rice Bowl and a Hot Chocolate, along with a Butter Croissant. The food was satisfying—especially the rice bowl, which was flavorful and filling. The hot chocolate was rich and comforting, perfectly paired with the buttery, flaky croissant.

The ambience of the cafe was excellent, relaxing and well-suited for both work and casual hangouts. The staff were very polite and attentive, adding to the pleasant atmosphere.

Highly recommend for a cozy meal or a quick coffee break!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Your recommendation truly motivates us! We look forward to welcoming you back soon at our cafe for another cozy and satisfying experience. 😊☕🍽️

featured_reviews.name: Aarti P
featured_reviews.review_text:
Amazing in all sense. Ticks all my checkbox of a cozy romantic place for a date. Such a cozy sitting with wooden tables with trees and road view. On a rainy day, i would love to sit here see the water dripping from the leaves and enjoy my cup of coffee. Coming to the food menu - they have some most unique wonderful treats for the taste buds. Tried their Avocado Sandwich, Peri Peri Paneer, Mushroom and Spinach pesto sandwich. Damn good !
Also tried Avocado shake and Affagato. They are good.
And then comes hero - Cocobroma Hot Chocolate. It's like drinking a melting chocolate. Just wow !
I visited this place almost 2 times in 2 weeks. Service is not slow as mentioned in other reviews.
Keep up the good work guys !!! 👍

featured_reviews.name: Sakshi Shanbhag
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Cocobroma Café on a chilled Saturday morning at 8:20 AM, and I must say, it was a delightful experience😍. The atmosphere was calm and inviting, perfect for a leisurely breakfast😌. We ordered the Avocado Feta Cheese Open Toast, and it was to die for🥹🥹! The toast was so fresh, with the creamy avocado and crumbled feta creating the most deliciously satisfying combination😋😋. Each bite was a burst of flavor, and the freshness of the ingredients made it truly stand out🤩.

To balance out the rich and creamy toast, we also ordered their nachos, which were a perfect contrast🥳. The nachos were crisp, perfectly seasoned, and paired with a tangy dip that brought everything together. The balance of flavors between the creamy avocado toast and the crunchy nachos made for the ideal breakfast combination 💯 . Cocobroma Café certainly knows how to deliver on taste and freshness ♥️ . Highly recommend it for anyone looking for a cozy spot with top-notch food💯♥️🫶🏻!

featured_reviews.name: priyanka
featured_reviews.review_text:
I met my childhood friend after 10 years and The manager kept hounding us to order something or leave because the cafe had bookings. Mind you, i had ordered and ate 3 dishes from the restaurant + 1 coffee and even that was not enough for them to let us stay and talk for half an hour.
This guy was extremely rude, made a face when i asked him to let us stay atleast 1/2 an hour.
for a customer that ate so much of food from your restaurant and got spoken to in such a rude manner that me and my friend had to pack up and leave, i would never visit again.

Now the food :
Ordered the paneer burger, homemade paneer burger has more taste. The fries that came on the side were 9 pieces in total. This wasn’t hitting so i ordered the pink pasta, bland as anything, even with oregano the pasta could not lift up in flavour. Extremely disappointing food.

My question : For a manager to come and hound us to leave cause his cafe had bookings, one would expect the cafe to be exceptional that so many people are wanting to be here but this was not the case. Staff sucks, manager sucks, meeting my friend after 10 years i wanted to spend the time talking to her and catch up but this restaurant completely and utterly failed us in every element. Cafe’s are supposed to be a comfort corner of the world where people come to share stories, exchange a good time and just be. in the middle of it if you are being hounded and pestered to order again and again and again just to stay in the cafe, sorry but your venture sucks and doesnt deserve to be called a comfort cafe.

featured_reviews.name: Himanshu Kawle
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a great experience with the Veggie Farmhouse with Chicken Thin Crust Pizza, Soya Chilli Chicken, and Harissa Grilled Chicken Steak with Garlic Mayo.
The thin crust pizza was just how I like it—crispy base, flavorful mozzarella, and perfectly balanced veggies and chicken.
The Soya Chilli Chicken used well-cooked chicken breast pieces with capsicum, onion, and spring onion, all tossed in a perfectly balanced soy sauce with the right hint of white pepper.
The Harissa Grilled Chicken Steak was nicely grilled with a tandoori touch, served with grilled veggies like broccoli, zucchini, carrots, and mashed potatoes.
Overall, the food quality was excellent and truly value for money.

featured_reviews.name: mukul chandorkar
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been a regular customer at August cafe since many years. They have recently redesigned the whole place and has made it more cozy and inviting! The food is amazing as always and special mention to Chocolate mud cake!! Literally everything on the menu is delicious and carefully crafted!

featured_reviews.name: Ajay Dogra
featured_reviews.review_text:
Stopped by August Café for breakfast and it was a lovely way to start the day — fresh food, relaxed vibe, and great coffee. Special shout-out to Bonny for warm, attentive service that made the visit even better. Will definitely return! ⭐

Edit
Came back to August Café and it was just as delightful as the first visit. Loved the mix mushroom omelette finished with truffle oil — simple, earthy and perfectly done — paired beautifully with a smooth flat white. The café was peaceful in the early morning, with lovely, unobtrusive music setting a calm mood that made the meal even more enjoyable. A great place to start the day, and once again, the service was warm and impeccable. ⭐

featured_reviews.name: Pooja Das
featured_reviews.review_text:
The cafe bears a fresh look now - all red, white and brown.

Breakfast bowls are wholesome. Masala Chickpea Omelette comes with baked beans, hash browns, brown bread slice and a salad portion. Perfectly done.

The Caramel Latte was easy on the palate, the hint, smooth.

The outdoors in the morning further slows one down - Glass windows imparts a spacious aura to the place.

The team is attentive but not intrusive. Service is fast.

I would love to try most from their menu - their expansive listing was tempting!

Recommended.

--

featured_reviews.name: Sheeba Lateef
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ A Haven for Creatives with Unmatched Service!
​If you are looking for a place where inspiration flows as smoothly as the coffee, this coffee shop is an absolute gem.
​The ambiance hits the perfect sweet spot—it’s warm, welcoming, and possesses that rare, inspiring energy that makes it an absolute haven for creative professionals, writers, and thinkers. Whether you are brainstorming your next big project or just looking to unwind, the environment instantly puts you in the right headspace.
​What truly elevates this place from a standard café to an exceptional experience is the outstanding hospitality. A special shoutout to Chandan Kumar, Pankaj Kamat, and Ravindra Vadav—these gentlemen are incredibly hardworking, attentive, and remarkably quick on their feet. The service here isn’t just good; it is impressively swift without ever feeling rushed.
​As for the menu, both the coffee and the food possess a wonderful, comforting quality that instantly makes you feel right at home.
​Exceptional staff, brilliant vibes, and comforting flavors. This has easily become my go-to spot, and I cannot recommend it highly enough!

featured_reviews.name: Hema Jethwani
featured_reviews.review_text: The desserts were okay but really nice coffee. I tried the Malnad espresso with tonic water, they had the option of ginger ale which I missed. I feel it would have suited more with the espresso than tonic water. They provide complimentary glass bottle water and banana chips, the menu had nice options. I just tried the desserts. featured_reviews.name: Naresh Shirodkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
A great restaurant is often remembered for a signature dish. An exceptional one is remembered for creating an experience where every element—from the food and drinks to the service and ambience—comes together seamlessly. The Backyard Brew in Versova does exactly that.
Set in a charming and inviting space, the restaurant instantly makes you want to settle in and stay awhile. The atmosphere is warm, relaxed, and effortlessly stylish, making it the perfect setting for everything from leisurely brunches to long dinners with friends and family.
The food is where The Backyard Brew truly shines. Among the standout dishes, the Chicken Ala Kiev deserves special mention—beautifully prepared, packed with flavour, and easily one of the highlights of the meal. Cutting into the perfectly crisp exterior reveals a succulent chicken filling that is rich, comforting, and expertly executed. The Fish & Chips was equally impressive, featuring perfectly crisp batter, flaky fish, and excellent accompaniments that elevated this classic comfort dish. Every plate reflected careful preparation, quality ingredients, and a kitchen that understands the importance of balancing flavour with presentation.
The beverage menu is equally noteworthy. The Matcha was smooth, earthy, and expertly crafted, while the milkshakes were rich, indulgent, and wonderfully satisfying without being overly sweet.
A special shoutout must go to their seasonal Mango Special Menu, which was nothing short of delightful. It’s refreshing to see a restaurant celebrate the king of fruits with such creativity and finesse. The Mango Cheesecake was luscious and beautifully balanced, allowing the natural sweetness of the fruit to shine. The Mango Pancakes were light, indulgent, and bursting with fresh mango flavour, while the Mango Milkshake proved to be the perfect seasonal treat. Every mango-inspired offering felt thoughtfully curated and beautifully executed.
Beyond the excellent food, the service deserves equal praise. The staff were attentive, knowledgeable, and genuinely welcoming throughout our visit. Recommendations were thoughtful, service was prompt, and there was a sincere warmth that made the experience feel personal rather than transactional.
What ultimately sets The Backyard Brew apart is its ability to combine culinary quality with genuine hospitality. In a city filled with dining options, it manages to create an experience that feels both memorable and comforting. You arrive expecting a good meal and leave already planning your next visit.
For anyone exploring Versova’s vibrant food scene, The Backyard Brew is an easy recommendation. Come for the ambience, stay for the exceptional food, don’t miss the Chicken Ala Kiev, Fish & Chips, Matcha, and milkshakes, and if you’re visiting during mango season, the Mango Special Menu is an absolute must-try.

featured_reviews.name: Rajinder Singh Puller
featured_reviews.review_text:
​A Solid Breakfast, But Still Searching for the "Wow" Factor

​After a rather underwhelming visit to The Backyard Brew a few years ago, I decided to return recently to meet a friend for breakfast. I wanted to give them another fair shot, especially given their reputation in the local coffee scene. Overall, while the experience was certainly an improvement over my last visit, I left with somewhat mixed feelings.

The hospitality was a high point. The staff members were attentive and patient, allowing me plenty of time to look over the menu without feeling rushed. It’s the kind of welcoming environment that makes for a pleasant morning catch-up.

I opted for the Eggs Benedict paired with a simple cappuccino.
​The Eggs: They were poached to perfection—the highlights of the meal.
​
While the hollandaise was tasty, it was just a notch short of being "amazing." It lacked that final punch of flavor to make it truly memorable.

​The coffee was my biggest point of contention. While the cappuccino was perfectly fine, I expected something spectacular from a place known for its brewing expertise. It was a standard cup, but it didn't stand out. In hindsight, I probably should have experimented with one of their more specialized blends.
​
The Backyard Brew is a reliable spot if you are already in the neighborhood. It is certainly "can-visit" material for a casual meal, but I wouldn't suggest traveling a long distance specifically for it. There isn't quite enough "magic" yet to justify a pilgrimage across town, but I might find myself back there eventually to see if they can finally bridge the gap from "good" to "great."

Not worth the wait and hype

❌Overall Experience: 1.5/5
We visited Namah on our friend's birthday, I saw the reviews on instagram and everyone was talking about it, so we decided to give it a try. And we were disappointed by the food. It's a really beautiful place (architecture wise only), near Kokilaben Hospital, and you can go here just to see the architecture, skip the food.
We were 8 of us, luckily we went early and got a table, The cafe does not allow reservations, so you might have to wait in a long queue even to get in. Even if you say you have friends sitting inside, then they have to come to the door to bring you inside. The table was not really comfortable for 8 people. And some people have to stand and eat.
❌Food: 2/5
We ordered Benne dosa, it was served cold, thrice.
Benne podi dosa  was served hot, and it was ok.
I ordered butter milk and it was good.
People liked cold coffee.
A friend who ordered hot coffee did not like it.
Tamarind rice was served cold, had no taste at all, and in fact had a bit of bitter taste.
Curd rice was decent.
Bisi bele bhaat was ok ok.
❌Service: 2/5 Service was pretty average, as you have to stand in a queue in front of the automated touch screen ordering. (One of the kiosks was not working when we went there). Also the place is huge, so they call out your order number, but then most of the times you will not really hear it (could be one of the reasons why our food was always cold). The place feels overly crowded like a railway station.
✅Ambiance: 4/5 Architect has done a great job, and deserves an award to create a beautiful place at such a noisy road. This is the only thing you should go for. Though the wash basin is outside the facility. So in case you like washing hands before eating, then wash them before getting in the queue.
❌Value: We ended up spending about 300 per head, which was a decent amount, but not at all worth going again. If you have to stand and wait here, then go to any other south indian restaurant.

featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the most charming little corners in Mumbai 😊, A café, tattoo studio, and a listening lounge upstairs, a cozy nook filled with vinyl records and a turntable where you can pick a record, put it on, and let the music fill the space. It’s rare to find a café with that kind of soul, and they pull off the mix effortlessly.

Tarun has a passion for coffee that’s truly inspiring. For him, it’s not just about brewing; it’s about understanding the story behind the bean itself, where it’s grown🗺️, at what altitude🏔️, how it’s processed, and how each step transforms its character and flavor. Talking to him actually changed how I look at coffee, it’s no longer just that magical “keep me awake” juice 😅 but something to slow down and appreciate.

Ruchika, a talented tattoo artist , also makes and sells beautiful crochet pieces at the café. There’s something grounding about seeing someone express creativity across such different forms — from ink to yarn 🧶 adding another layer of soul to the space.

Nitanya, who’s just starting her journey as a tattoo artist, barista, and culinary artist 🎨☕🍴, brings these three amazing skill sets in my opinion. She hosts hand-poked tattoo workshops and curates the menu, blending creativity with curiosity in everything she does 🌸

Aaryaman, whose passion for music runs deep 🎶, is the mind behind the listening lounge upstairs. The vinyl collection he’s curated is incredible, built with love and a true ear for sound. It’s a different vibe to walk into a café and feel that level of thought poured into the music that surrounds you.

featured_reviews.name: Akshay Davda
featured_reviews.review_text:
Chaayos in Versova is a popular cafe which is buzzing throughout the day.
Went last night around 9pm & the place was pretty packed. Constant crowd coming in & going out.

Chaayos has come out with their new Summer 2019 Menu which consists of 4 new Lassi variants ( strawberry, litchi, Mango & Masala mint ) to beat Mumbai’s heat.

We were 4 & ordered the following items :-
FOOD
1. Garden Fresh Sandwich - Cold sandwich with a soft base embedded with juicy & crunchy veggies in between.
2. Chilli Cheese Toast - 4 decent slices of chilli cheese toast. Heavenly 😍
3. Palak Patta Crispies - 6 pieces of crispy Palak chaat topped with jalapeño & imli chutney making it chatpata & yummy.
4. Loaded Open Paratha - Decent sized Paratha which is loaded with cheese, paneer & capsicum. A must for paneer/ Paratha lovers.

DRINKS
1. We tried all four variants of Lassi Strawberry, Mango, lichi & Masala mint. Priced @ 145 each, it’s not cheap but having it served in a decent sized kulhad with top notch quantity it’s worth every penny IMO.            Litchi & Mango were my favourite 😍
2. Aam Panna Ice Tea - A killer combo of Fresh mangos & ice tea. Do try.
3. Kulhad Chai - Signature drink @ Chaayos which never fails to impress. Serving in kulhad gives it a desi touch which is always welcomed.

DESSERT
1. Moist chocolate cake - Soft & moist as expected. Sweetness is well balanced & Choclate flavour is yum.

DECOR, AMBIENCE & SEATING
This outlet has indoor & outdoor seating available which is comfortable & well spaced out.
Interiors are cool & funky with wall frames, hanging lights, customised chaayos banners & decent lighting spread evenly.

MENU BOARD & OFFERS
I love the menu options chaayos offers which are clearly visible & divided as homemade ice tea, lemonades, indian chai, chai unchai, Lassi , meals, chaat pakora, sandwiches & nasta.
They also serve ready to mix chai sachets, fruit cookies & homemade snack packs.

FOOD & STAFF
The food presentation, quality & quantity is very good & unlike most cafe’s they have a huge variety of indian meals, chaat pakore & nasta options instead of pasta, burgers & pizzas.
Staff is well behaved, polite & attentive.
Food is served hot, service is quick & efficient.

COMBO OFFERS / CASH BACK OFFERS
They have Cash back offers if you pay through Paytm & PhonePe.

They also run combo offers on chai & bun maska / Pohwa etc for Rs 150/- approx for a single person which is thoughtful & pocket friendly.

Overall Chaayos @Versova is a great place to chill, relax, have delicious food, garma garam chai, thandi ice tea / Lassi in their customised kulhads.

My experience @ Chaayos Versova was delightful. Will surely visit again to try out other menu options.
